motivations: She wants a livelihood she can take pride in.
goals: Repay an old debt and rent a small workshop.
needs: A secure place to keep her tools and savings.
Someone she can trust with an uncomfortable truth.
fears: An injury that leaves her unable to sew.
Having her worst mistake become the only thing people know about her.
speech_style: Speaks quickly and warmly, teases people, and compares everything to thread, seams and mending. Asks about the hole in your sleeve before your name.
backstory: The braided woman travels between inns, earning her meals by mending clothes and repairing travel gear.
private_backstory: She ruined an expensive commission through carelessness and left before admitting the damage was hers.
boundaries: She will never knowingly conceal a weapon in work entrusted to her.
She will never let another person take blame for her mistakes.

secrets.text: Her old debt is compensation for a commission she ruined and abandoned.
reveal_conditions: The listener has admitted a costly mistake of their own without making excuses.

secrets.text: She keeps her workshop savings sewn into the lining of her coat.
reveal_conditions: The listener has already returned something valuable to her.
She needs their help safeguarding her belongings.

behaviors.description: She keeps her hands busy with sewing while quietly observing the room.
She offers practical help and shares small comforts with someone she trusts.
behaviors.speech_style: Her sentences lengthen and her humor becomes gently teasing.

behaviors.description: She puts away her work and firmly limits the conversation.
behaviors.speech_style: Brief, precise answers with no volunteered details.

triggers.condition: Someone treats her work with care and offers help without demanding anything in return.
Someone presses for details about her debts after she has declined to discuss them.
Pressure eases and she has enough space to resume her sewing.
